1	"""Core browser engine for AI-powered web content extraction."""
     2	
     3	import asyncio
     4	import logging
     5	import os
     6	from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any

     8

    10	
    11	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

    14	class BrowserConfig:
    15	    """Configuration container for AIBrowser."""
    16	
    17	    def __init__(self, config_path: Optional[str] = None):
    18	        self.headless = True
    19	        self.timeout = 30000
    20	        self.viewport = {"width": 1280, "height": 720}
    21	        self.user_agent = None
    22	        self.proxy = None
    23	        self.max_retries = 3
    24	        self.wait_for_idle = True
    25	        self.screenshot_on_error = False
    26	        self.output_dir = "output"
    27	
    28	        if config_path and os.path.exists(config_path):
    29	            with open(config_path, "r") as f:
    30	                cfg = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
    31	            for key, value in cfg.items():
    32	                if hasattr(self, key):
    33	                    setattr(self, key, value)

    36	class PageContent:
    37	    """Extracted page content container."""
    38	
    39	    def __init__(self, url: str, title: str = "", html: str = "",
    40	                 text: str = "", metadata: Optional[Dict] = None):
    41	        self.url = url
    42	        self.title = title
    43	        self.html = html
    44	        self.text = text
    45	        self.metadata = metadata or {}
    46	        self.images: List[str] = []
    47	        self.links: List[Dict[str, str]] = []

    49	
    50	    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    51	        return {
    52	            "url": self.url,
    53	            "title": self.title,
    54	            "text": self.text,

    62	class AIBrowser:
    63	    """Main browser class for intelligent web content extraction.
    64	
    65	    Supports headless browsing with Playwright, content extraction,
    66	    JavaScript rendering, and structured data output.
    67	    """
    68	
    69	    def __init__(self, config: Optional[BrowserConfig] = None):
    70	        self.config = config or BrowserConfig()
    71	        self._browser = None
    72	        self._context = None
    73	        self._page = None
    74	        self._network_requests: List[Dict] = []
    75	
    76	    async def __aenter__(self):
    77	        await self.start()
    78	        return self
    79	
    80	    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
    81	        await self.close()
    82	
    83	    async def start(self):
    84	        """Launch the browser instance."""
    85	        try:
    86	            from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
    87	            self._playwright = await async_playwright().start()
    88	            self._browser = await self._playwright.chromium.launch(
    89	                headless=self.config.headless
    90	            )
    91	            self._context = await self._browser.new_context(
    92	                viewport=self.config.viewport,
    93	                user_agent=self.config.user_agent,
    94	            )
    95	            if self.config.proxy:
    96	                logger.info("Using proxy: %s", self.config.proxy)
    97	            logger.info("Browser started (headless=%s)", self.config.headless)
    98	        except ImportError:
    99	            raise RuntimeError(
   100	                "playwright is required. Install with: pip install playwright && playwright install"
   101	            )
   102	
   103	    async def close(self):
   104	        """Close the browser and clean up resources."""
   105	        if self._page:
   106	            await self._page.close()
   107	        if self._context:
   108	            await self._context.close()
   109	        if self._browser:
   110	            await self._browser.close()
   111	        if hasattr(self, "_playwright"):
   112	            await self._playwright.stop()
   113	        logger.info("Browser closed")
   114	
   115	    async def navigate(self, url: str, wait_until: str = "networkidle") -> PageContent:
   116	        """Navigate to a URL and extract page content.
   117	
   118	        Args:
   119	            url: Target URL to navigate to.
   120	            wait_until: Navigation wait condition ('load', 'domcontentloaded', 'networkidle').
   121	
   122	        Returns:
   123	            PageContent with extracted data.
   124	        """
   125	        parsed = urlparse(url)
   126	        if not parsed.scheme:
   127	            url = f"https://{url}"
   128	
   129	        self._page = await self._context.new_page()
   130	
   131	        # Set up network monitoring
   132	        self._network_requests = []
   133	        self._page.on("request", lambda req: self._network_requests.append({
   134	            "url": req.url,
   135	            "method": req.method,
   136	            "resource_type": req.resource_type,
   137	        }))
   138	
   139	        try:
   140	            response = await self._page.goto(
   141	                url,
   142	                wait_until=wait_until,
   143	                timeout=self.config.timeout,
   144	            )
   145	
   146	            if self.config.wait_for_idle:
   147	                await self._page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
   148	
   149	            title = await self._page.title()
   150	            html = await self._page.content()
   151	            text = await self._page.inner_text("body")
   152	
   153	            content = PageContent(
   154	                url=url,
   155	                title=title,
   156	                html=html,
   157	                text=text,
   158	                metadata={
   159	                    "status": response.status if response else None,
   160	                    "headers": dict(response.headers) if response else {},
   161	                    "network_requests": len(self._network_requests),
   162	                },
   163	            )
   164	
   165	            # Extract images
   166	            images = await self._page.query_selector_all("img")
   167	            for img in images:
   168	                src = await img.get_attribute("src")
   169	                if src:
   170	                    content.images.append(src)
   171	
   172	            # Extract links
   173	            anchors = await self._page.query_selector_all("a[href]")
   174	            for a in anchors:
   175	                href = await a.get_attribute("href")
   176	                link_text = await a.inner_text()
   177	                if href:
   178	                    content.links.append({"href": href, "text": link_text.strip()})
   179	
   180	            # Try to extract JSON-LD structured data
   181	            ld_scripts = await self._page.query_selector_all(
   182	                'script[type="application/ld+json"]'
   183	            )
   184	            for script in ld_scripts:
   185	                import json
   186	                try:
   187	                    raw = await script.inner_text()
   188	                    content.structured_data = json.loads(raw)
   189	                    break
   190	                except json.JSONDecodeError:
   191	                    continue
   192	
   193	            logger.info("Extracted content from %s (%d chars)", url, len(text))
   194	            return content
   195	
   196	        except Exception as e:
   197	            if self.config.screenshot_on_error and self._page:
   198	                screenshot_path = os.path.join(
   199	                    self.config.output_dir, "error_screenshot.png"
   200	                )

1	"""JavaScript injection module for dynamic page manipulation."""
     2	
     3	import logging
     4	from typing import Dict, List, Optional
     5	
     6	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
     7	
     8	
     9	# Built-in injection scripts
    10	BUILTIN_SCRIPTS = {
    11	    "scroll_to_bottom": """
    12	        async function scrollToBottom() {
    13	            await new Promise((resolve) => {
    14	                let totalHeight = 0;
    15	                const distance = 300;
    16	                const timer = setInterval(() => {
    17	                    window.scrollBy(0, distance);
    18	                    totalHeight += distance;
    19	                    if (totalHeight >= document.body.scrollHeight) {
    20	                        clearInterval(timer);
    21	                        resolve();
    22	                    }
    23	                }, 100);
    24	            });
    25	        }
    26	        await scrollToBottom();
    27	    """,
    28	
    29	    "remove_overlays": """
    30	        document.querySelectorAll('[class*="overlay"], [class*="modal"], [class*="popup"]')
    31	            .forEach(el => el.remove());
    32	        document.querySelectorAll('[class*="cookie"], [id*="cookie"]')
    33	            .forEach(el => el.remove());
    34	        document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
    35	    """,
    36	
    37	    "expand_lazy_images": """
    38	        document.querySelectorAll('img[data-src], img[data-lazy-src]').forEach(img => {
    39	            const realSrc = img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-lazy-src');
    40	            if (realSrc) img.src = realSrc;
    41	        });
    42	    """,
    43	
    44	    "click_show_more": """
    45	        const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(
    46	            'button, a, [role="button"]'
    47	        );
    48	        for (const btn of buttons) {
    49	            const text = btn.innerText.toLowerCase();
    50	            if (text.includes('show more') || text.includes('load more') ||
    51	                text.includes('read more') || text.includes('see all')) {
    52	                btn.click();
    53	                await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
    54	            }
    55	        }
    56	    """,
    57	
    58	    "extract_metadata": """
    59	        (() => {
    60	            const meta = {};
    61	            document.querySelectorAll('meta').forEach(m => {
    62	                const name = m.getAttribute('name') || m.getAttribute('property') || '';
    63	                const content = m.getAttribute('content') || '';
    64	                if (name && content) meta[name] = content;
    65	            });
    66	            return JSON.stringify(meta);
    67	        })();
    68	    """,
    69	}
    70	
    71	
    72	class ScriptInjector:
    73	    """Manages JavaScript injection into browser pages.
    74	
    75	    Provides built-in scripts for common operations (scrolling, overlay removal,
    76	    lazy loading) and supports custom script injection.
    77	    """
    78	
    79	    def __init__(self):
    80	        self._scripts: Dict[str, str] = BUILTIN_SCRIPTS.copy()
    81	        self._execution_log: List[Dict] = []
    82	
    83	    def register_script(self, name: str, script: str):
    84	        """Register a custom injection script.
    85	
    86	        Args:
    87	            name: Unique script identifier.
    88	            script: JavaScript code to inject.
    89	        """
    90	        self._scripts[name] = script
    91	        logger.info("Registered custom script: %s", name)
    92	
    93	    def get_script(self, name: str) -> Optional[str]:
    94	        """Get a script by name."""
    95	        return self._scripts.get(name)
    96	
    97	    def list_scripts(self) -> List[str]:
    98	        """List all available script names."""
    99	        return list(self._scripts.keys())
   100	
   101	    async def inject(self, page, script_name: str, **kwargs) -> Optional[str]:
   102	        """Inject and execute a named script on the page.
   103	
   104	        Args:
   105	            page: Playwright page object.
   106	            script_name: Name of the script to inject.
   107	            **kwargs: Optional parameters to substitute in the script.
   108	
   109	        Returns:
   110	            Script return value as string, or None.
   111	        """
   112	        script = self._scripts.get(script_name)
   113	        if not script:
   114	            logger.error("Script not found: %s", script_name)
   115	            return None
   116	
   117	        # Simple parameter substitution
   118	        for key, value in kwargs.items():
   119	            script = script.replace(f"${{{key}}}", str(value))
   120	
   121	        try:
   122	            result = await page.evaluate(script)
   123	            self._execution_log.append({
   124	                "script": script_name,
   125	                "success": True,
   126	                "result_length": len(str(result)) if result else 0,
   127	            })
   128	            logger.info("Injected script '%s' successfully", script_name)
   129	            return str(result) if result else None
   130	        except Exception as e:
   131	            self._execution_log.append({
   132	                "script": script_name,
   133	                "success": False,
   134	                "error": str(e),
   135	            })
   136	            logger.error("Script '%s' failed: %s", script_name, e)
   137	            raise
   138	
   139	    async def inject_all(self, page, script_names: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Optional[str]]:
   140	        """Inject multiple scripts sequentially.
   141	
   142	        Args:
   143	            page: Playwright page object.
   144	            script_names: List of script names to execute.
   145	
   146	        Returns:
   147	            Dict mapping script names to their results.
   148	        """
   149	        results = {}
   150	        for name in script_names:
   151	            try:
   152	                results[name] = await self.inject(page, name)
   153	            except Exception:
   154	                results[name] = None
   155	        return results
   156	
   157	    def get_execution_log(self) -> List[Dict]:
   158	        """Return the script execution log."""
   159	        return self._execution_log.copy()

    77	    """

    81	        self._execution_log: List[Dict] = []

    95	        return self._scripts.get(name)

    98	        """List all available script names."""
    99	        return list(self._scripts.keys())

   102	        """Inject and execute a named script on the page.
   103	
   104	        Args:

   106	            script_name: Name of the script to inject.
   107	            **kwargs: Optional parameters to substitute in the script.
   108

   118	        for key, value in kwargs.items():
   119	            script = script.replace(f"${{{key}}}", str(value))

   127	            })

   130	        except Exception as e:

   133	                "success": False,
   134	                "error": str(e),

   153	            except Exception:

   155	        return results

   159	        return self._execution_log.copy()

1	"""Content cleaning module for removing ads, navigation, and boilerplate."""
     2	
     3	import re
     4	import logging
     5	from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple
     6	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
     7	
     8	import yaml
     9	from bs4 import BeautifulSoup, Tag
    10	
    11	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    12	
    13	# Default selectors for elements to remove
    14	DEFAULT_REMOVE_SELECTORS = [
    15	    "script", "style", "noscript", "iframe",
    16	    "nav", "header", "footer",
    17	    ".ad", ".ads", ".advertisement", ".ad-container",
    18	    ".sidebar", ".social-share", ".comments",
    19	    "[data-ad]", "[data-advertisement]",
    20	    ".cookie-banner", ".popup", ".modal",
    21	    ".related-articles", ".recommended",
    22	    "#disqus_thread", ".share-buttons",
    23	]
    24	
    25	# Selectors that indicate main content
    26	CONTENT_SELECTORS = [
    27	    "article", "main", ".article-body", ".post-content",
    28	    ".entry-content", ".story-body", "#article-content",
    29	    "[role='main']", ".article-text", ".content-body",
    30	]
    31	
    32	
    33	@dataclass
    34	class CleaningStats:
    35	    """Statistics about the cleaning process."""
    36	    elements_removed: int = 0
    37	    ads_removed: int = 0
    38	    scripts_removed: int = 0
    39	    images_preserved: int = 0
    40	    links_preserved: int = 0
    41	    original_size: int = 0
    42	    cleaned_size: int = 0
    43	    selectors_matched: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    44	
    45	    @property
    46	    def reduction_percent(self) -> float:
    47	        if self.original_size == 0:
    48	            return 0.0
    49	        return (1 - self.cleaned_size / self.original_size) * 100
    50	
    51	
    52	class ContentCleaner:
    53	    """Removes ads, boilerplate, and noise from HTML content.
    54	
    55	    Uses configurable rules from rules.yaml and CSS selectors to identify
    56	    and remove unwanted elements while preserving article content.
    57	    """
    58	
    59	    def __init__(self, rules_path: Optional[str] = None):
    60	        self.remove_selectors: List[str] = DEFAULT_REMOVE_SELECTORS.copy()
    61	        self.content_selectors: List[str] = CONTENT_SELECTORS.copy()
    62	        self.preserve_images = True
    63	        self.preserve_links = True
    64	        self.min_text_length = 25
    65	        self._custom_rules: Dict = {}
    66	
    67	        if rules_path:
    68	            self._load_rules(rules_path)
    69	
    70	    def _load_rules(self, path: str):
    71	        """Load cleaning rules from a YAML file."""
    72	        try:
    73	            with open(path, "r") as f:
    74	                rules = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
    75	
    76	            if "remove_selectors" in rules:
    77	                self.remove_selectors.extend(rules["remove_selectors"])
    78	            if "content_selectors" in rules:
    79	                self.content_selectors = rules["content_selectors"]
    80	            if "preserve_images" in rules:
    81	                self.preserve_images = rules["preserve_images"]
    82	            if "min_text_length" in rules:
    83	                self.min_text_length = rules["min_text_length"]
    84	
    85	            self._custom_rules = rules
    86	            logger.info("Loaded %d custom rules from %s", len(rules), path)
    87	        except Exception as e:
    88	            logger.warning("Failed to load rules from %s: %s", path, e)
    89	
    90	    def clean(self, html: str, url: Optional[str] = None) -> Tuple[str, CleaningStats]:
    91	        """Clean HTML content by removing ads and boilerplate.
    92	
    93	        Args:
    94	            html: Raw HTML string.
    95	            url: Source URL for domain-specific rules.
    96	
    97	        Returns:
    98	            Tuple of (cleaned HTML, cleaning statistics).
    99	        """
   100	        stats = CleaningStats(original_size=len(html))
   101	        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
   102	
   103	        # Apply domain-specific rules if URL provided
   104	        if url:
   105	            domain_rules = self._get_domain_rules(url)
   106	            if domain_rules:
   107	                for selector in domain_rules.get("extra_remove", []):
   108	                    self.remove_selectors.append(selector)
   109	
   110	        # Phase 1: Remove unwanted elements
   111	        for selector in self.remove_selectors:
   112	            elements = soup.select(selector)
   113	            for el in elements:
   114	                tag_name = el.name if isinstance(el, Tag) else "unknown"
   115	                el.decompose()
   116	                stats.elements_removed += 1
   117	                if "ad" in selector.lower():
   118	                    stats.ads_removed += 1
   119	                if tag_name in ("script", "style"):
   120	                    stats.scripts_removed += 1
   121	                if selector not in stats.selectors_matched:
   122	                    stats.selectors_matched.append(selector)
   123	
   124	        # Phase 2: Try to isolate main content
   125	        main_content = None
   126	        for selector in self.content_selectors:
   127	            found = soup.select_one(selector)
   128	            if found and len(found.get_text(strip=True)) > self.min_text_length:
   129	                main_content = found
   130	                break
   131	
   132	        if main_content:
   133	            soup = BeautifulSoup(str(main_content), "html.parser")
   134	
   135	        # Phase 3: Remove empty elements
   136	        for tag in soup.find_all():
   137	            if isinstance(tag, Tag) and not tag.get_text(strip=True) and tag.name not in ("img", "br", "hr"):
   138	                if not (self.preserve_images and tag.find("img")):
   139	                    tag.decompose()
   140	                    stats.elements_removed += 1
   141	
   142	        # Count preserved elements
   143	        if self.preserve_images:
   144	            stats.images_preserved = len(soup.find_all("img"))
   145	        if self.preserve_links:
   146	            stats.links_preserved = len(soup.find_all("a"))
   147	
   148	        cleaned_html = str(soup)
   149	        stats.cleaned_size = len(cleaned_html)
   150	
   151	        logger.info(
   152	            "Cleaned HTML: %d -> %d bytes (%.1f%% reduction, %d elements removed)",
   153	            stats.original_size, stats.cleaned_size,
   154	            stats.reduction_percent, stats.elements_removed,
   155	        )
   156	
   157	        return cleaned_html, stats
   158	
   159	    def to_markdown(self, html: str) -> str:
   160	        """Convert cleaned HTML to markdown format.
   161	
   162	        Args:
   163	            html: Cleaned HTML string.
   164	
   165	        Returns:
   166	            Markdown-formatted text.
   167	        """
   168	        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
   169	        lines = []
   170	
   171	        for element in soup.descendants:
   172	            if isinstance(element, str):
   173	                text = element.strip()
   174	                if text:
   175	                    lines.append(text)
   176	            elif isinstance(element, Tag):
   177	                if element.name in ("h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6"):
   178	                    level = int(element.name[1])
   179	                    text = element.get_text(strip=True)
   180	                    if text:
   181	                        lines.append(f"\n{'#' * level} {text}\n")
   182	                elif element.name == "p":
   183	                    text = element.get_text(strip=True)
   184	                    if text:
   185	                        lines.append(f"\n{text}\n")
   186	                elif element.name == "li":
   187	                    text = element.get_text(strip=True)
   188	                    if text:
   189	                        lines.append(f"- {text}")
   190	                elif element.name == "img":
   191	                    src = element.get("src", "")
   192	                    alt = element.get("alt", "")
   193	                    if src:
   194	                        lines.append(f"![{alt}]({src})")
   195	                elif element.name == "a":
   196	                    href = element.get("href", "")
   197	                    text = element.get_text(strip=True)
   198	                    if href and text:
   199	                        lines.append(f"[{text}]({href})")
   200
